core_question: How do I clean my saxophone after each time I play it? (secondary: How do I get a blood stain out of clothing?)
answer_summary: Run a cleaning swab through the neck and body to remove condensation, wipe down the mouthpiece and reed, and let the instrument air out before closing the case.; after the topic shift: Rinse or soak the stain in cold water right away, since hot water sets blood stains; then wash normally.
persona: skeptical and testy; chatty and verbose
